component.name: Stales
component.summary: Fast, keyboard-driven web browser with an Arc-style sidebar

description.p: Stales is a quiet, fast browser for Linux written in Rust on WebKitGTK. Tabs live in a sidebar (or along the top), everything works from the keyboard, and every colour, shortcut and setting can be changed.

ul.li: Arc-style sidebar with Spaces, pinned tabs and a command bar
Vimium-style keyboard control with link hints
Built-in ad and tracker blocker using uBlock Origin's filter lists
Themes, per-Space colours and your own CSS with live reload
